ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: humbled by an oath
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has carried {PAWN_possessive} pride more lightly since swearing the colony's oath to {LABEL}.

li.news: {PAWN_nameDef} has been quieter since swearing the colony's oath to {LABEL}.

plain.li: I swore the colony's oath to {LABEL} at the gate today. I didn't think I could. It turns out I can.
The oath to {LABEL} is sworn, and I was the one who swore it. I keep going over the words in my head.
I always said I'd answer to nobody. Today I swore the colony to {LABEL}, and the sky stayed where it was.

warm.li: I swore the oath to {LABEL} so the others would be safe. That's worth more than my pride, I think.

blunt.li: Swore the oath to {LABEL}. Didn't like it. Did it anyway.

cheerful.li: I swore the colony's oath to {LABEL} today and nobody laughed. I may survive this after all.

gloomy.li: I answer to {LABEL} now. That's who I am, someone who answers to others.

cold.li: The oath to {LABEL} was the sensible choice. My pride will have to be sensible too.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: broke the colony's word twice
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has trusted promises less since breaking the colony's word to {LABEL}, the second time in a year.

li.news: {PAWN_nameDef} has broken the colony's word twice in a year now, and seems to trust words less for it.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: faced challengers
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has stood a little straighter since facing {LABEL}, the second challenger in a year.

li.news: {PAWN_nameDef} has faced a second challenger this year, and seems less afraid of the next one.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: a second season abroad
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has been more curious about the world since a second season away among {LABEL}.

li.news: {PAWN_nameDef} has set out for {LABEL} a second time this year, and seems more at ease among strangers.
